trade.text: Joined a Supreme Court brief challenging the president’s unilateral tariffs, arguing that they raise prices and harm consumers and businesses.
trade.quote: These chaotic on-again, off-again tariffs are not just lawless, they are hurting Americans, driving up prices for consumers and crushing small businesses.

debt.text: Lofgren vowed to protect Social Security from cuts.
debt.quote: Retirees deserve secure retirement benefits after a lifetime of hard work, and I am fully committed to protecting Social Security from Republicans' attempts to dismantle it.

schools.text: Lofgren has repeatedly voted against federally funded private-school voucher programs, including the DC Opportunity Scholarship Program.
schools.quote: Voted NO on reauthorizing the DC opportunity scholarship program.

immigration.text: Describes herself as a champion of comprehensive immigration reform and a defender of DACA.
immigration.quote: Zoe is recognized by her colleagues and immigration advocates as an established champion of comprehensive immigration reform, a national leader on immigration policy, and a staunch defender of DACA

guns.text: Lofgren supports requiring background checks for all commercial gun sales.
guns.quote: The Public Safety and Second Amendment Rights Protection Act would require background checks to be completed for all commercial gun sales to prevent domestic abusers and felons from obtaining firearms

abortion.text: Lofgren condemned the Dobbs decision and supports codifying Roe v. Wade into law.
abortion.quote: Democrats in the House have already passed legislation to enshrine Roe v. Wade in law.

health.text: Opposed a Senate funding agreement because it did not immediately extend Affordable Care Act tax credits to lower health-care costs.
health.quote: Americans need their healthcare costs to be lowered now. Getting the "promise of a vote" to extend ACA tax credits a month from now is just not good enough

energy.text: Joined lawmakers calling for an end to new offshore oil and gas leasing and restoration of a pathway for offshore wind and other clean-energy projects.
energy.quote: We write to express our strongest opposition to any effort to open new offshore oil and gas leasing

voting.text: Defended California’s vote-by-mail system and urged the Justice Department not to take actions that intimidate voters or reduce participation.
voting.quote: We will not tolerate federal interference in Californians’ right to vote, including by the Department engaging in any form of intimidation of immigrant communities.

tax.text: Lewis proposes a simple low flat tax of roughly 7% on workers' wages to cut federal tax liability.
tax.quote: Introduce a simple, low flat tax of approximately 7% for American workers' wages and salaries.

debt.text: Lewis calls for gradually reducing federal deficit spending to address a national debt exceeding $39 trillion.
debt.quote: I support a responsible, gradual reduction in deficit spending by 2% annually

schools.text: Lewis backs a Parent and Student Empowerment Act that ties a portion of education funding directly to students.
schools.quote: This act gives families more say by tying a portion of education funding directly to students, increasing transparency and accountability.

immigration.text: Lewis proposes expanding and reforming the H-2A visa program as a controlled tool for seasonal agricultural labor.
immigration.quote: Expand and reform the H-2A visa program as a vetted, controlled tool for seasonal agricultural labor.

energy.text: Lewis favors an all-of-the-above energy strategy emphasizing affordable, reliable energy using abundant domestic resources.
energy.quote: The smartest path forward is an all-of-the-above energy strategy
